description: T-0959: where the 1-ulp differences near POWER come from. A1-A9: the steps of POWER.xlsx inside_a_lambda's gelu at x = 0.5 (0.5*x*(1+TANH(SQRT(2/PI())*(x+0.044715*POWER(x,3))))), whose cached value Excel gives as 0.3457140098251439. A10-A12: TANH at nearby points. A13-A20: positive-base twins of power-odd-root-tolerance A72/A74 and power-odd-root-tolerance-2 A19, and the exp/ln steps of 1E300^(1/3).
